_comment: Headset standing-mode effects per era (Implementation Plan 2.6; product doc 'Standing modes'). Calibrated estimates, not measured: FastF1 can't observe them. Start modest, tune by playtesting. lapDelta: s added per lap. wearMult: multiplies tyre wear (effective tyre age advances by this per lap). errorMult: multiplies the era's base error rate; only the excess over 1 is applied. attackLogit / defendLogit: added to the overtake model's logit when this car attacks / is attacked.
